'''Ronald Raphael Coifman''' ({{Langx|he|רונלד קויפמן}}; born June 29, 1941) is a [[Sterling professor]] of Mathematics at [[Yale University]]. Coifman earned a doctorate from the [[University of Geneva]] in 1965, supervised by [[Jovan Karamata]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=5851}}</ref>

Coifman is a member of the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]], the [[Connecticut Academy of Science and Engineering]], and the [[United States National Academy of Sciences|National Academy of Sciences]]. He is a recipient of the 1996 [[DARPA]] Sustained Excellence Award, the 1996 Connecticut Science Medal, the 1999 Pioneer Award of the International Society for Industrial and Applied Science, and the 1999 [[National Medal of Science]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://cpsc.yale.edu/people/ronald-coifman|title=Ronald Coifman, Ph.D., University of Geneva, 1965|publisher=[[Yale University]]|access-date=26 October 2016}}</ref><ref>[https://www.nsf.gov/od/nms/recip_details.cfm?recip_id=86 National Science Foundation – The President's National Medal of Science]</ref>

Prior to teaching at Yale, Coifman taught at [[Washington University in St. Louis]] and the [[University of Chicago]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2000-02-01 |title=Yale mathematician awarded Presidential Medal of Science |url=https://news.yale.edu/2000/02/01/yale-mathematician-awarded-presidential-medal-science |access-date=2023-11-23 |website=YaleNews |language=en}}</ref>

In 2013, he co-founded [[ThetaRay]], a [[computer security|cyber security]] and [[big data|big data analytics]] company.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thetaray-cybersecurity-idINKCN0IA1JV20141021|title=Israel's ThetaRay turns to maths to detect cyber threats|date=21 October 2014|publisher=[[Reuters]]|access-date=1 June 2017}}</ref>

In 2018, he received the [[Rolf Schock Prizes|Rolf Schock Prize]] for Mathematics.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.kva.se/en/pressrum/pressmeddelanden/en-matematiker-en-logiker-en-solist-och-en-italiensk-avantgardist-tilldelas-rolf-schockprisen-2018|title=A mathematician, a logician, a soloist and an Italian avant-gardist are awarded the Rolf Schock Prizes 2018 |date=March 15, 2018 |publisher=[[Swedish Royal Academies]]}}</ref> In 2024 he was awarded the [[George David Birkhoff Prize]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/news?news_id=7238 George David Birkhoff Prize 2024]</ref>
